proof_summary: For the candidate linear-recurrence solution \(C_n\), the proof constructs an auxiliary sequence \(R_n\) and inductively establishes the Cassini-type identity \(C_{n+1}^2=C_nC_{n+2}+R_n\) with \(0<R_n\le C_n\). These remainder bounds force \(\lceil C_{n+1}^2/C_n\rceil-1=C_{n+2}\), so induction identifies the original recursively defined terms with \(C_n\).
